purpose: Teach: 交信/逆説/マニフェスト/点在/入港/強者/待合室/首席

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外研究者との交信を欠かすな
lines.en: Ren — don't let your correspondence with overseas researchers lapse.
lines.style: Direct, measured. Brief pause before the name. Clipped delivery on the instruction itself. Not harsh, but exacting — the tone of someone who expects compliance and has earned the right to it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。逆説的仮説も論文で検証します
lines.en: Yes. I'll test the paradoxical hypothesis in the paper as well.
lines.style: Quiet, careful. Slight hesitation — showing he's processing, not just nodding along. Steady breath beneath the words. The earnestness of someone taking notes in his head.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究マニフェストを起草しろ
lines.style: Firm, economical. Each word lands. Eyes on him. No softening, no elaboration. A task given by someone who trusts the recipient to understand its weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。サンプルが全国に点在しております
lines.en: Yes. The samples are scattered across the country at different points.
lines.style: Acknowledging. Slight tightness in the delivery — naming a real logistical challenge without complaint. The voice of someone taking a problem seriously and already thinking through it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究船の入港時に立ち会え
lines.en: Ren — be present when the research vessel comes into port.
lines.style: Clear command. The name stands alone. Deliberate pacing. This matters, the tone says. Not negotiable, not optional. The voice of authority that doesn't raise itself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当分野の強者の論文も読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the papers from the leaders in this field as well.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal. A breath of commitment underneath. Careful not to over-promise, but the words carry the sense of someone willing to put in the work without fanfare.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、被験者の待合室を整えろ
lines.en: Ren — prepare the waiting room for the test subjects.
lines.style: Specific, practical. Delivered as a directive but not dismissive. A small task that matters. The tone carries an assumption of competence and care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学年首席として後輩に範を示します
lines.en: Yes. As class representative, I'll set an example for the underclassmen.
lines.style: Steady, quiet pride underneath. No boasting — just stating what he'll do. Breath even and controlled. The voice of someone who takes responsibility as privilege, not burden.
